field_principles.change_proposal_written: BARE bool -- true means the operator-wiring change proposal exists and the conductor was not modified.
field_principles.classifier_only_recommends: BARE bool -- true means the classifier recommends pause+escalate and never prunes, edits, or relaxes verification.
field_principles.classifier_shipped: BARE bool -- scripts/anomaly_escalation_classifier.py exists and runs.
field_principles.clean_vs_anomaly_examples: Example classifications showing at least one clean bounded negative and one frame-violating anomaly.
field_principles.inference_substrate: A classifier over artifact metadata, no live model; prevents confusing this prototype with a compute-bound experiment.
field_principles.n_test_artifacts_classified: Count of example artifacts run through the classifier; sample evidence that the prototype executes on concrete artifact metadata.
field_principles.never_relaxes_verification: BARE bool -- true means design and proposal forbid auto-relaxing verification; valley funding stays human-gated.
field_principles.tests_assert_real_behavior: BARE bool -- true means shipped tests assert the real classifier behavior rather than a poisoned placeholder.
